reason: The cited evidence discusses alumina scale formation on Ti-Al and Nb-Al intermetallics, but none of it involves the specific equiatomic HfNbTaTiZr alloy or pack cementation on it. The key premises about forming a protective layer on this alloy and preserving its mechanical properties are therefore unsupported by the provided passages.
premises: Pack cementation can form an ultrathin Al-enriched surface layer on equiatomic HfNbTaTiZr
This Al-enriched layer will transform into a continuous, dense, protective Al₂O₃ scale upon oxidation
The Al₂O₃ scale will act as an effective oxygen diffusion barrier
The treatment will not degrade the alloy's room-temperature ductility or high-temperature yield strength
